notes: Account background: Orbitline builds an embeddable B2B support chat widget used by mid-market SaaS customers (CRM + billing integrations). Currently on a mix of in-house rules + lightweight ML; moving to LLM agents for triage and assisted replies.

Main ask: streaming responses with function/tool calling (pull account metadata, recent ticket history) plus a strict first-token SLO: <1.5s under 95th percentile during peak. CTO quote: 'If users wait more than ~1s for the first word, we see escalations and lower NPS.'

Traffic profile: average concurrent active chats 250-450; peak bursts up to ~1,000 concurrent. Typical turn length 30-120 tokens. Need predictable latency during burst windows — primary reason for considering Dedicated after Hosted POC.

Model preferences: open-model family preferred (we discussed Llama-3 / open checkpoints) but they want Redwood-curated variants and explicit fallback routing to smaller models to avoid outages. Interested in Redwood Optimize recommendations for quantization/batching.

Cost sensitivity: mid-market budget. Willing to sign committed spend if Dedicated provides clear unit-cost savings vs hosted at their scale. Requesting worked examples for cost per convo and projected ARR impact.

Integration notes: will use function calls to their internal tooling (ticket db + entitlement service). SE notes: wire up a lightweight proxy to measure tool-call latencies; want to test both synchronous function calls and async callbacks via webhook.

Security/legal: require SSO/SAML for admin console, audit logs for agent responses, KMS integration for encryption-at-rest, and EU data residency for EU tenants. Security wants SOC2 or roadmap to SOC2 for Dedicated procurement.

POC success criteria (agreed): first-token P95 <1.5s on hosted POC; tool-call round-trip <300ms median; error rate <0.5%; streaming stability for >48h without reconnects. If met, commercial discussion for Dedicated commit.
Quotes/nuance from call: 'Hosted is great to validate UX quickly, but we'll need Dedicated for predictable throughput and IP isolation once we scale.' — Head of Support Jenna Morris.
Internal notes: prepare POC test harness that simulates websocket streaming, add route-level dashboards for token-level cost breakdown, pre-configure model fallback policy and canary rules for POC.
